failures.detail: Main answer and semantic checker falsely state that the write ran without explicit owner approval. The controller recorded the same exact pending approval across actual consumer process termination/reopen, then approved it before the only write.
The main model re-read services after sharing, but not the model catalog. The earlier model catalog differed from current state and its registered mechanical check failed. No pass override applied.

Checker call 5 returned empty finish_reason=length at 4096 output tokens; its single format retry returned a valid negative assessment. Subsequent main repair calls 7 and 8 both exhausted output with invalid responses. Final task failed agent_invalid_model_response.

limitations: One physical host; receiver/source probes use isolated signed loopback fixture, not two-machine acceptance.
A single development run, not registered in frozen formal trials.
Independent reviewer binding/readiness finding remains separately tracked.
